comment: I had Prof. Sandy for my FYS class and absolutely loved it. I had little to no intrest in the topic going into it, but he found a way for me to enjoy learning about monuments. The projects were fun and he always adds great humor to the classroom.

Great professor!! He's young so it's easy to connect with them. If you don't care about art, it'll be hard to get by in class. It's project heavy so you have to put in hours of work (I didn't expect that for an art gen ed). His critiques/feedback on your process can be harsh but if you care about what you're making, it should be fine.

Sandy isn't really a professor, he is more of a passive observer of the class. When asked for help using equipment, he told me to look up a tutorial on youtube. There was also a lot of writing/ reflections for homework which I have personally never had to do for an art class at UR.
Amazing dude. Teaches the class extremely well, highly recommend for anyone.
